note: Hand-made pronuclear calls that the automatic pipeline cannot produce. Every entry here overrides build_pronuclei_assignments.py, and the page marks the result as a MANUAL call rather than letting it read as an algorithm's output. Applied by scripts/patch_pronuclei_assignments.py, which is idempotent and re-runnable, and re-applied at the end of build_pronuclei_assignments.py so a full rebuild cannot silently drop these. An entry for an embryo the build already produced keeps that build's geometry and tests untouched and changes only the sex call; an entry for an embryo the build dropped entirely has its geometry recomputed from the segmentation meshes.

overrides.reason: The automatic detector dropped this zygote entirely: M4 protrudes about 12 um out of the cytoplasm (64% of its voxels lie outside segment 1), so it was classified as an external body rather than a pronucleus. It is a pronucleus, and the zygote is a usable datapoint. M3 sits far closer to the polar body (31 um vs 68 um), which makes it maternal; M4 sits far closer to the sperm (26 um vs 48 um), which independently makes it paternal.
overrides.caveat: M4 is partly outside the segmented cytoplasm, so its volume and centroid are less reliable than a fully interior pronucleus.

overrides.reason: Called by eye: the larger pronucleus (M3, 10,161 um3) is maternal, the smaller (M2, 6,610 um3) is paternal. No polar body is detected in this zygote and no sperm is labelled, so both polar-body tests and the sperm test are unavailable — the volume heuristic was the only test running, and this call overrides it.
overrides.caveat: This call DISAGREES with the volume heuristic, which assumes the smaller pronucleus is maternal. No automatic test supports or contradicts it independently.
